summary: Template-binding drift in support routing causes incorrect assignee mapping in eu-west
description: Issue summary: Template binding resolution started returning incorrect, region-agnostic groups for tickets created in eu-west after the template catalog v2.14.1 sync on 2026-03-11. Impact: internal tickets routed to US on-call groups, causing missed SLAs for EU support queues and delayed escalations. This ticket captures investigation, mitigations, and next steps.
impact: ~20 internal tickets observed misrouted between 2026-03-11T20:00 and 2026-03-12T08:00 UTC. Estimated SLA breaches: 5 tickets beyond 4-hour target. Affects internal-assignment automation and escalation paths for EU customers.
steps_to_reproduce: Create a support ticket via tooling API with template key 'dedicated_egress' and region eu-west
Observe routing history: assigned_group resolves to 'redwood-oncall-us' instead of 'redwood-oncall-eu'
Query templates-service /bindings endpoint for template and region; note returned binding value
logs: 2026-03-11T20:03:42Z router INFO binding_lookup template=dedicated_egress region=eu-west resolved_group=redwood-oncall-us
2026-03-11T20:04:05Z syncer ERROR apply_template catalog_version=v2.14.1 job=template-syncer request_id=abc123
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: schema/field change in v2.14.1 allowed empty region-scoped binding to be treated as fallback; router defaults empty->us-group.
Reproduced locally by loading catalog v2.14.1 with legacy templates: binding resolution returned empty region key and fallback_group present.
Observed a race between template-syncer job writing bindings and routing cache invalidation; cache read during partial write returned stale/partial payload.
Telemetry: misrouting spikes align with template-syncer deploy at 2026-03-11T19:58Z and high cache eviction churn in eu-west.
Related: INT-38912 flagged TTL inheritance issues in bulk imports; possible overlap with the syncer change-set.
workaround: Pinned router to stable release router@2026-03-10-rc1 (roll-back of latest router defaulting behavior) and disabled template auto-syncer in eu-west. Manually reassigned affected tickets to redwood-oncall-eu and re-ran escalation checks.
resolution: Mitigation in place (router pinned + auto-sync disabled). Templates-service PR #2873 enforces explicit region-scoped binding and atomic write. Router patch to treat empty binding as no-match (do not default to 'us') is under review; deploy scheduled for 2026-03-15. Postmortem and permanent rollback plan to be documented in Confluence.
